requests: Startup noise causes unused YM1..3 to stay visible in supplied file
Remove other forced basic-channel visibility rules
Add remote Show all channels checkbox

confirmed_cause.explanation: YM base lanes were forced visible regardless of usage. Independent live audio-activity flags can contain startup artifacts; they are not used for the new decision.

implementation.YM: Whole timed VGM program union of per-slot FM keys and DAC enable/data or stream starts; setup/stop/reset without timed notes does not imply use. Genuine one-tick intro notes and later/partial-slot notes retained. No arbitrary intro time cutoff.
implementation.other_chips: Primary OPL1/OPL2, AY8930 and SN76489 have no blanket base exemption; existing ES/SCC/OKI whole-program rules retained.
implementation.console_exceptions: NES5base APU includingDMC,GB4,SNES8 only; NES expansions still follow known usage
implementation.general: WholeTrackUsage wrapper uses authoritative existing usage or a physical finite decoded end/validated VGM duration. Full unmuted offline frames, reset to beginning, cache per selection,10s soft budget. Only a completed pass or all channels proven used yields a mask. Length tags alone do not prove an executable ROM/PSF end; unknown/failure/timeout retains all from the start.
implementation.all_option: Remote checkbox2115, native auto-checkbox at y298, enlarged remote390high. Persist showAllChannels. When checked overrides automatic and manual hiding; unchecking restores both prior states. Right-click manual hide disables the override. No mute/gain changes.
implementation.audio: Visibility only; actual3s8-float mix/stems byte identical to baseline; original source file unchanged

validation.YM: 5own reset/brief-intro/late/partial-slot/directDAC/streamDAC cases; supplied YM1..3+DAC hidden, YM4..6 shown at initial load; controls/rewind do not change list
validation.generic: Known finite early/late/silent channel union, exact initial PCM restore, cached replay/mute restore; unknown/failed scans never claim prefix as whole-track; real decoder errors remain observable
validation.console_and_chips: Fresh visibility tests show NES5/GB4/SNES8 base exceptions, unused AY1-of3, late ES before first note; OPL/SN own usage checks and native UI pass
validation.visual_review: New checkbox visible with no overlap; automatic recording screenshot contains YM4..6 and13total labels, no YM1..3; other metadata hidden
validation.audio_method: Dummy/offscreen own processes; no physical listening or driver changes

failed_candidates: Own actual-YM test initially assumed a live activity flag for lateYM4 would be false; startup artifacts can set that flag, so assertions now use the actual full-program note record and precomputed visibility.

Old UI expectations assumed every GBA/DS lane visible; conservative finite-end rule retains unknown executable ends, tests preserve unknown cases. A tag-only scan prototype was removed to avoid hiding notes beyond a metadata tag.
Chip waveform pixel test counted only first3 palette colors. With unused YM lanes removed the active high-index ES lane had another color; corrected to all8 real channel colors.
Recording edge test cropped a fixed y300..600 range. A freely moving sine can leave that slice; corrected to the complete first recording lane, still requiring exact right-edge containment.
limits: No claim of universal game-driver usage detection. Unknown/infinite execution ends, failed/too-slow scans retain channels rather than guess.

Generic offline scan threshold1e-7 is on raw unmuted PCM, not live/user volume. Metadata commands are preferred where available; arbitrary audible startup data in unmodeled formats is not automatically identifiable as noise.
Soft10s budget checked between decoder blocks, not forced cancellation of an individual native decode call.
No physical listening, actual driver removal, forced OOM or malformed decoder stress newly injected
